column1: # Redrawing a border is one line per province.
# The controller may be left out when the owner holds it. Provinces this file does not
# mention keep the owner the base game gives them, so a mod that moves one border does
# not have to restate the other thirty-seven thousand.
# Province ids come from game/map_data/definition.csv, and the full base-game map is in
# game/history/provinces/ownership.csv - copy the lines you want from there.
# The two examples below are commented out because a template that silently annexed
# something on first load would be a rude thing to ship.
